verdict.rationale: The evidence describes building AI agents with no code: you give an agent a goal and tools and it decides the steps itself. Nothing in the pack documents a visual editor, canvas, or drag-and-drop builder for laying out multi-step workflows. No-code agent configuration is an adjacent capability, not the visual workflow builder this story asks for.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build multi-step workflows in a visual editor without writing code
